today_summary: GCM26 marks $4,697.1, a fifth consecutive higher session and +$17.6 on the day. The chain is structurally call-dominated at P/C OI 0.36 (201,914 calls vs 73,621 puts), with net GEX of +503 within ±$200 of spot — dealers are deeply long gamma and actively suppressing realized vol. Max pain sits at $6,000, $1,303 above spot, so it is an artifact of the 27,048-contract $8,000 call book rather than a usable magnet. The 1σ daily move on 24.77% ATM IV is $73.3 (1.56%).
five_day_thesis: Spot has advanced $277.1 (+6.3%) in five straight sessions from $4,420 with no down day, and the notable feature is that ATM IV expanded alongside it, 22.51% → 24.77% (+2.26pp) — spot-up/vol-up is chase behavior, not a healthy grind. The gamma flip has been pinned at $4,510 for four consecutive sessions while spot climbed, widening the long-gamma cushion from +$34 on 2026-08-20 to +$187 today; near-spot net GEX nearly doubled over the window, 271.6 → 503.1. That combination is the whole thesis: dealers are longer gamma the higher price goes, which caps upside velocity and explains why a 6.3% rally has arrived in $20–$110 increments rather than a gap. Max pain repriced down once, $6,200 → $6,000 on 2026-08-24, the only structural adjustment in the window — writers rolled the far call book lower rather than defending it. The put book has not moved with spot at all: the heaviest put OI still sits at $3,900–$4,000, roughly 15% below market, which means the downside hedge is crash insurance, not a proximate floor.

prediction: Bias constructive but range-bound above $4,510. With net GEX +503 near spot, the path of least resistance is a grinding advance into the $4,800 call shelf (5,730 OI, +80.2 GEX) rather than an impulse move, and each 1σ day is worth only $73. The bias fails below $4,510 — that is the gamma flip, and beneath it dealer hedging reverses to vol-amplifying with no meaningful put OI until $4,300 (2,571) and the real wall at $3,900 (3,799).
